configured_remote_protocols.title: Configured Remote Transport Protocols
configured_remote_protocols.description: List of transport protocol schemes used in git remote URLs across repository and CI/CD configurations (e.g., 'git', 'http', 'https', 'ssh'). Covers both developer workstation remotes and CI/CD pipeline repository connection protocols.

plaintext_protocol_enforcement_blocked.title: Plaintext Protocol Enforcement Blocked
plaintext_protocol_enforcement_blocked.description: Whether the repository host or network controls actively reject or redirect git:// and http:// protocol connections, preventing their use even if clients attempt them.

minimum_tls_version_enforced.title: Minimum TLS Version Enforced
minimum_tls_version_enforced.description: The minimum TLS protocol version configured and enforced on the HTTPS git endpoint (server, reverse proxy, or ingress controller). Used for both downgrade attack assessment and weak cipher evaluation.

tls_version_enforcement_configured.title: TLS Version Enforcement Explicitly Configured
tls_version_enforcement_configured.description: Indicates whether a minimum TLS version constraint is explicitly configured on the git HTTPS endpoint, rather than relying on default or inherited system settings.

hmac_signature_validation_enabled.title: HMAC Signature Validation Enabled
hmac_signature_validation_enabled.description: Whether the CI/CD pipeline engine or webhook consumer validates the HMAC signature on incoming webhook payloads using a shared secret before processing the event.

shared_secret_configured.title: Webhook Shared Secret Configured
shared_secret_configured.description: Whether a shared secret has been provisioned on both the repository host (sender) and the CI/CD pipeline engine (receiver) for use in HMAC webhook payload signing.

webhook_source_ip_allowlist_enforced.title: Webhook Source IP Allowlist Enforced
webhook_source_ip_allowlist_enforced.description: Whether the CI/CD pipeline engine restricts incoming webhook requests to an allowlist of known repository host IP ranges as a compensating control.

mutual_tls_enabled.title: Mutual TLS Enabled on CI-to-Repository Connection
mutual_tls_enabled.description: Whether the CI/CD pipeline engine is configured to present a client certificate (mTLS) when connecting to the repository host, enabling bidirectional identity verification.

client_certificate_path_configured.title: Client Certificate Path Configured
client_certificate_path_configured.description: Whether a client TLS certificate file path (and corresponding private key) is explicitly configured in the CI/CD pipeline's repository connection settings, as required for mTLS.

strict_host_key_checking.title: SSH StrictHostKeyChecking Setting
strict_host_key_checking.description: The value of StrictHostKeyChecking in SSH client configuration used for git operations. 'yes' enforces host key verification, 'no' disables it entirely, 'accept-new' accepts new keys without verification.

known_hosts_baseline_configured.title: Trusted known_hosts Baseline Present
known_hosts_baseline_configured.description: Whether a populated known_hosts file with trusted host key fingerprints is present and actively used for SSH git operations. False if no known_hosts file exists, the file is empty, or operations use UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null.

ssh_git_remote_urls_present.title: SSH-Based Git Remote URLs Present
ssh_git_remote_urls_present.description: Whether any git remote URLs in the repository or CI/CD pipeline configuration use the SSH protocol (git@... or ssh://...), meaning host key verification applies to actual operations.

timestamp_window_enforcement_enabled.title: Timestamp Window Enforcement Enabled
timestamp_window_enforcement_enabled.description: Whether the webhook consumer enforces a maximum acceptable delivery age (timestamp window) to reject replayed payloads outside the allowed window.

commit_signing_verification_enforced.title: Commit Signing Verification Enforced at Server
commit_signing_verification_enforced.description: Whether the Git server's receive-pack layer is configured to reject unsigned or invalidly signed commits (e.g., via pre-receive hook, branch protection rules with required signatures, or server-side GPG/SSH signature verification policy).

signing_verification_scope.title: Commit Signing Verification Scope
signing_verification_scope.description: The breadth of branches or refs on which commit signing verification is enforced. 'none' means no enforcement, 'default_branch_only' means only the primary branch, 'protected_branches' means all protected branches, 'all_refs' means all repository refs.

advertised_cipher_suites.title: Advertised TLS Cipher Suites
advertised_cipher_suites.description: List of cipher suites advertised by the Git server or CI/CD TLS endpoint during handshake negotiation, including any weak or export-grade entries.

tls_downgrade_protection_enabled.title: TLS Downgrade Protection Enabled
tls_downgrade_protection_enabled.description: Whether the server enforces TLS_FALLBACK_SCSV or equivalent mechanism to prevent protocol and cipher suite downgrade attacks.

lfs_transfer_endpoint_auth_required.title: LFS Transfer Endpoint Authentication Required
lfs_transfer_endpoint_auth_required.description: Whether the Git LFS batch API transfer endpoint enforces authentication (e.g., Bearer token, Basic auth) on object upload/download requests, independent of the core git HTTPS transport authentication.

lfs_transfer_protocol.title: LFS Transfer Protocol
lfs_transfer_protocol.description: The network protocol used for the actual LFS object upload/download transfer phase after the batch API negotiation. This may differ from the protocol used for the core git transport.

lfs_redirect_auth_forwarded.title: Authentication Forwarded on LFS Redirect
lfs_redirect_auth_forwarded.description: Whether authentication credentials are preserved and forwarded when the LFS batch API issues redirect responses (3xx) to a separate storage backend (e.g., S3, GCS, Azure Blob), ensuring the transfer endpoint is not accessed without authentication.

hsts_header_present.title: HSTS Header Present
hsts_header_present.description: Whether the repository HTTPS endpoint responds with an HTTP Strict-Transport-Security header on its HTTPS responses.

hsts_max_age_seconds.title: HSTS max-age Value (Seconds)
hsts_max_age_seconds.description: The numeric value of the max-age directive in the Strict-Transport-Security header. A value of 0 or absent indicates no effective HSTS protection. Minimum recommended value is 31536000 (one year).

https_endpoint_accessible.title: HTTPS Endpoint Accessible
https_endpoint_accessible.description: Whether the repository is reachable over HTTPS (i.e., port 443 responds with a valid TLS handshake), confirming that HSTS applicability should be evaluated.

webhook_egress_filtering_enabled.title: Webhook Egress Filtering Enabled
webhook_egress_filtering_enabled.description: Whether the repository platform enforces an allowlist or blocklist on outbound webhook destination URLs, preventing delivery to internal/private IP ranges, cloud metadata endpoints, or other restricted targets.

webhook_url_validation_mode.title: Webhook URL Validation Mode
webhook_url_validation_mode.description: The level of validation applied to user-supplied webhook destination URLs before delivery. 'none' means any URL is accepted without checks. 'syntax_only' means only format is verified. 'dns_resolved_allowlist' means URLs are resolved and checked against an allowlist. 'strict_allowlist' means only pre-approved destinations are permitted.

webhook_auth_required_on_delivery.title: Webhook Delivery Requires Recipient Authentication
webhook_auth_required_on_delivery.description: Whether the platform requires webhook recipient endpoints to present authentication (e.g., HMAC signature verification enforced at dispatch, mutual TLS, or token validation) before payload delivery.

clone_rate_limiting_enabled.title: Clone Rate Limiting Enabled
clone_rate_limiting_enabled.description: Whether per-source-IP or per-token rate limiting is enforced on the git clone/fetch endpoint to prevent bulk repository exfiltration.

repository_visibility.title: Repository Visibility
repository_visibility.description: The access level of the repository — public repositories are accessible without credentials, making rate limiting and HSTS more critical. Used across clone rate limiting and HSTS evaluations.

rpki_validation_enforced.title: RPKI Route Origin Validation Enforced
rpki_validation_enforced.description: Indicates whether RPKI (Resource Public Key Infrastructure) route origin validation is enforced on the network paths serving repository hosts, preventing BGP route hijacking.

git_transport_protocol.title: Git Transport Protocol
git_transport_protocol.description: The transport protocol used for git clone and push operations to the repository host. Determines whether traffic is protected by TLS, making interception via BGP hijack detectable or exploitable.

tls_certificate_pinning_enabled.title: TLS Certificate Pinning Enabled
tls_certificate_pinning_enabled.description: Indicates whether TLS certificate pinning or strict CA validation is configured for git operations, preventing transparent TLS interception by an adversary operating a rogue BGP-hijacked endpoint.
